description.value: Cantina di Luigi is a dimly lit Italian wine bar nestled in the back of Mercato di Luigi in Vancouver's Chinatown, offering a curated all-Italian wine list by the glass, half litre, or bottle alongside pasta, cheeses, and cured meats. It is part of the Kitchen Table Restaurants group and shares its style of service with the well-regarded Ask for Luigi next door. The space is designed for slow, convivial dining with an emphasis on small-producer and indigenous Italian grape varieties.
